name: the customer web portal
label: Customer web portal

modes.title: Sign-in failing
modes.symptom: sign-in attempts ending on a blank page
customer_says: I can't log in to my account on the website. I enter my details and get a white screen.
The website won't sign me in. It thinks about it for ages and then shows nothing.
I'm trying to get into my online account, and the page just goes blank after the password.
Logging in to the portal doesn't work. No error, no account, just an empty page.

causes.cause: a single sign-on service that lost its database connection
fixes: restoring the single sign-on service's database connection

causes.cause: a broken release of the sign-in page
fixes: rolling back the sign-in page release

causes.cause: a load balancer sending visitors to a server that was switched off
fixes: removing the dead server from the load balancer

workarounds: sign in through the Meridian mobile app, which uses a separate route
open the portal in a private browsing window and sign in with a one-time code
aftercare: clear the browser's saved cookies for the Meridian site before signing in
use the usual sign-in page rather than any bookmarked link

modes.title: Bills not displaying
modes.symptom: the billing page showing no statements
customer_says: My bills have disappeared from the website. The billing page says there are no statements.
I can't see or download my latest bill online. The page is just empty.
The account page loads, but when I click on bills there is nothing there at all.
I need a copy of my bill and the portal says no documents found.

causes.cause: a document store that went offline during a storage upgrade
fixes: bringing the document store back after the storage upgrade

causes.cause: a billing interface returning empty results after a schema change
fixes: reverting the schema change on the billing interface

causes.cause: an expired access key between the portal and the statement archive
fixes: issuing a new access key for the statement archive

workarounds: request a copy of the bill by email through the automated phone line
view the latest balance on the account summary page, which is unaffected
aftercare: reload the billing page to see the restored statements
download any statement that was needed during the fault

modes.title: Orders and changes not saving
modes.symptom: orders and plan changes failing at the final step
customer_says: I'm trying to upgrade my package on the website and it fails right at the end, every time.
The portal won't let me finish an order. I press confirm and get sorry, something went wrong.
I've tried three times to change my plan online, and it never goes through.
The website gets all the way to the last page of my order and then throws an error.

causes.cause: an order management service that stopped accepting new requests
a stock checking call that timed out for every product
fixes: bypassing the failing stock checking call

causes.cause: a pricing catalogue published with invalid entries

workarounds: save the basket and complete the order later from the saved basket link
place the order through the chat option on the help pages
aftercare: check the orders page for any duplicate order before trying again
complete the saved basket once the confirmation step is working

modes.title: Pages loading slowly
modes.symptom: account pages timing out before they load
customer_says: The Meridian website is impossibly slow. Half the pages time out before they show anything.
I can sign in, but every page in my account takes minutes or just fails to load.
The portal keeps saying the page took too long to respond.
Your website is hanging on every click. Other websites are fine for me.

causes.cause: a runaway database query from the usage reporting page
a cache layer that was emptied by a failed deployment
a flood of automated traffic against the portal
fixes: blocking the automated traffic at the network edge

workarounds: use the lightweight mobile version of the portal
avoid the usage page and go directly to the page that is needed
aftercare: refresh the page once rather than clicking repeatedly
sign out and back in if pages still load slowly

wrong_customer_side: a browser extension that blocks the page
an account locked after too many wrong passwords
a workplace firewall blocking the site
wrong_provider_side: the monthly bill run slowing the site down
a redesign of the website going live
routine maintenance scheduled for the portal
a fault at another internet provider
